kashika: आमः परस्य लेर्लुग् भवति। ईहांचक्रे। ऊहांचक्रे। ईक्षांचक्रे॥
kashikaEnglish: च्लि is added after roots before लुङ् (aorist). The actual substitute is सिच् or others specified below.
englishShort: The लकार that follows the 'आम्' प्रत्यय is removed.
englishFull:
There is लुक् elision of the tense-affix (ल्) that comes after आम् in the periphrastic perfect (लिट्).

**Example:**
ईहांचक्रे "he endeavored"

After ईहाम्, all tense-affixes are elided; the periphrastic perfect of कृ/  भू/  अस् supplies the ending.
